bias.zh: 看空 · 守住 $609–612，位于 100 日和 200 日均线下方

read.en: Meta fell 1.5% on Oct 30 to $614.99, trading between $610.14 and $626.37, after a 2.0% bounce on Oct 29 that peaked at $634.7. It is below the falling 5-day ($620.6), 10-day ($649.1), 30-day ($706.9) and 200-day ($632.1) averages and the rising 100-day ($631.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($679.23), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: Meta 10月30日下跌 1.5%，收于 $614.99，盘中区间 $610.14–626.37；此前 10月29日反弹 2.0%，高点 $634.7。股价位于下行的 5 日（$620.6）、10 日（$649.1）、30 日（$706.9）和 200 日均线（$632.1）以及上行的 100 日均线（$631.7）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$679.23），RSI 为 33。

read.en: No level changed: the Oct 29 high poked above the $630.9–632.1 averages and faded, and $609–612.4 held again. Resistance is $619.2–626.4 (5-day, Oct 27 low, Oct 30 high), then $631.7–634.7 (100 and 200-day, Oct 29 high) and $639.7 (Oct 22 low). Support is $609–612.4, then $600 (Jan 20 low) and $592.6–594.8 (May lows). A close below $609 would open $593–600; above $634.7, $640.

s.en: Aug 11 high $612.4; Oct 28 low $609.0; Oct 30 low $610.1
